newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - Regional CPI on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - Regional CPI on Thursday.

text.p: The German state of Hesse said it expects to publish its consumer price index for April at 0700 GMT on Thursday April 24.
The state statistics offices of Baden-Wuerttemberg and Bavaria said they also expect to publish their price data on Thursday.
North Rhine-Westphalia published its data on Tuesday.
Inflation figures from the four states are used to calculate preliminary consumer inflation for west Germany, which is scheduled to be announced on April 25 or April 28.
In March, the west German consumer price index fell by 0.1 percent month-on-month and rose by 1.6 percent year-on-year.
The pan-German consumer price index fell by 0.2 percent month-on-month and rose by 1.5 percent year-on-year.
